tax.text: He criticized the Inflation Reduction Act for raising taxes and supported tax repeal legislation.
tax.quote: The misleadingly named “Inflation Reduction Act,” (IRA) will raise taxes on every income bracket, hire 87,000 additional IRS agents to enforce those taxes, cut jobs, reduce medical innovation opportunities, and certainly worsen inflation.

wages.text: He voted against the Raise the Wage Act, which would have raised the federal minimum wage.
wages.quote:
Vote Question: On Passage

Raise the Wage Act

Vote Type: Recorded Vote

safety.text: Westerman said rising violent crime makes support for law-enforcement officers increasingly critical.
safety.quote: With violent crime on the rise, including crime against police, it's becoming more and more critical that we support the men and women at the forefront of keeping us safe.

immigration.text: He supported strict border security and voted for the Secure the Border Act.
immigration.quote: securing our communities through strict border security, unleashing American energy, and saving billions of American taxpayer dollars

guns.text: Westerman voted No on the Bipartisan Background Checks Act.
guns.quote: Vote Question: On Passage Bipartisan Background Checks Act Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay Status: Passed

abortion.text: He praised the reversal of Roe v. Wade and said abortion is not a right.
abortion.quote: Life is a right. Abortion is not. Our system of government is not based on unelected judges creating a right that doesn’t exist in the Constitution.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He voted for the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

cannabis.text: He voted against the MORE Act, which would have federally decriminalized marijuana.
cannabis.quote:
Vote Question: On Passage

MORE Act

Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay

energy.text: He supported the Lower Energy Costs Act and backed expanded domestic energy production.
energy.quote: I rise today in support of H.R. 1, the Lower Energy Costs Act.

voting.text: He voted for the SAVE Act, which would add documentary citizenship checks to federal voter registration.
voting.quote:
Vote Question: On Passage

Bill Title & Description: SAVE Act

Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay

tax.text: He proposes a tax on the wealthiest Americans to help address homelessness.
tax.quote: And by adding a small tax on the super-rich—the top 0.1%—we can help end homelessness for good.

wages.text: He says laws should raise wages and treat workers fairly.
wages.quote: We need fair laws that raise wages, make sure everyone gets equal pay for equal work, and treat all workers fairly.

guns.text: He says he supports both Second Amendment rights and unspecified common-sense reforms.
guns.quote: I am committed to preserving our 2nd Amendment rights while fighting for common sense reform.

abortion.text: In a 2022 interview, he said women should be able to control their own bodies.
abortion.quote: Russell says he supports the rights of transgender people and women to control their own bodies.

health.text: He supports expanding Medicare and moving toward health care for everyone.
health.quote: We can fix this by expanding Medicare and moving toward healthcare for everyone.

energy.text: He supports investing in a clean energy future that uses multiple sources.
energy.quote: We need to invest in a clean energy future that uses multiple sources to stay safe and strong.
